seo_title: No Essay Computer Science Scholarships - 43 Options
seo_description: Explore 43 computer science scholarships with no essay required. Award sizes range from $500 to $40,000. Check deadlines promptly.
intro: Finding scholarships that support your computer science education can be challenging, especially when you're looking to avoid the hassle of essay writing. This curated list features 43 scholarships specifically for computer science students that do not require essays, making the application process more straightforward. Award sizes vary significantly, with amounts ranging from approximately $500 to $40,000. Keep in mind that while many listings have fewer requirements, it’s essential to check each one for specific details and deadlines, as they can vary widely.
